svg.title: Sidecar / Process & Authority Boundaries
svg.desc: Inspect clear boundary separations between the TUI, tmux PTY processes, untrusted agent runtimes, and remote hosts.. Solid colored outlines mark exact authored boundary members; dotted outlines mark collapsed elements that contain members. Neither is an inferred trust envelope.
